chunks: Then the worst of what they had done overtook them. So will the evil deeds of those who are sinners among them recoil back on them. They cannot get the better (of Us).
ai.seo_question: What happens to the evil deeds of those who wrong themselves according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the principle of 'return to the self' (rujū' ilā al-nafs), where divine retribution is the intrinsic consequence of one's own deeds rather than an external imposition. It underscores the inevitability of accountability, noting that the wrongdoers cannot escape God's power (mu'jizīn) through any means, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (ʿadl) where actions directly manifest their results.
